description: Analytics Dashboard - Create AnalyticsCharts component with Recharts integration showing listings by category, claims over time, status distribution, impact metrics, and CSV export functionality
steps: Create client/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsCharts.jsx using Recharts library (already installed v2.10.3)
Implement BarChart for food listings by category over last 30 days using data from dashboard API
Implement LineChart for claims over time trend using historical claim data
Implement PieChart for listing status distribution (available, claimed, completed, expired)
Add impact metrics calculations: total food redistributed (kg/portions), CO2 saved estimate (0.5kg CO2 per kg food), meals equivalent
Add CSV export button that downloads dashboard analytics data as formatted CSV file
Integrate AnalyticsCharts component into client/src/pages/restaurant/Dashboard.jsx below existing stats cards
acceptance_criteria: AnalyticsCharts component renders three charts using Recharts library
Charts display actual data from GET /api/dashboard/restaurant endpoint
Impact metrics show calculated values for food redistribution and environmental impact
CSV export downloads complete dashboard data in tabular format
Charts are responsive and work on mobile/tablet viewports
Empty data states show appropriate messages when no data is available
verification: Navigate to restaurant dashboard and verify three charts render with data
Test CSV export button downloads file with correct data format
Verify impact metrics calculations are accurate based on food listing quantities
Check charts are responsive on mobile viewport (375px width)
Test with account that has no data to verify empty state handling
